entities.name: Rafael Escuredo Rodríguez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Rafael Escuredo Rodríguez is a Spanish politician and lawyer, member of the Spanish Socialist Workers' Party of Andalusia, who was President of Andalusia between 1979 and 1984. After his presidency, he served as a mediator on behalf of the family of Anabel Segura when she was kidnapped in 1993.
